title: Briefe der Fruchtbringenden Gesellschaft und Beilagen: die Zeit Fürst Ludwigs von Anhalt-Köthen 1617-1650, Band 1: 1617-1626 (HAB Wolfenbüttel)
institution: Herzog August Bibliothek Wolfenbüttel, with the Sächsische Akademie der Wissenschaften zu Leipzig; edition by Klaus Conermann and Dieter Merzbacher
notes: Electronic TEI P5 edition of the first volume of the letters and enclosures of the Fruchtbringende Gesellschaft (Fruitbearing Society), a German literary and linguistic society, from the printed edition of 1992. Readable and downloadable without login: the METS file lists each letter's TEI file (briefe/*.xml). The 91 letter files are dated 1617-1626. The online edition is dated 2014 and the files were last modified between 2015 and 2018, so it is marked archived. Later volumes (1627-1650) are not part of this record. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
license_note: The METS record links the HAB CC BY-SA 3.0 Germany notice as the work's rights statement; the TEI headers only carry the HAB copyright line.
